translationReview: Kinyarwanda functional copy authored in this continuation; fluent operator review remains required.

entries.en: The original action committed. Refresh the records before starting another action; do not repeat it.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cya mbere cyemejwe. Banza uvugurure amakuru mbere yo gukora ikindi; ntukigisubiremo.
Inyemezabwishyu ibitswe ya kera kurusha izindi

entries.en: Use an administrator-issued pairing code for the approved business wallet and receiving phone. Pairing does not credit a member.
entries.rw: Koresha kode yatanzwe n’umuyobozi ku ikofi ry’ubucuruzi na telefoni yakira byemejwe. Guhuza ntibishyira amafaranga kuri konti y’umunyamuryango.

entries.en: This account is not approved for this phone. Contact admin.
entries.rw: Iyi konti ntiyemerewe iyi telefoni. Vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: Screen transitions only. Android controls keyboard and dialog animations.
entries.rw: Bireba gusa guhinduranya amadirishya. Android ni yo igenzura imigendere ya clavier n’amadirishya y’ibiganiro.

entries.en: Statement export cancelled. Open the member and try again.
entries.rw: Gusohora urutonde byahagaritswe. Fungura umunyamuryango wongere ugerageze.

entries.en: The subscription number is Android metadata, not the MoMo phone number or proof of wallet ownership.
entries.rw: Nimero y’umurongo ni amakuru ya Android; si nimero ya MoMo kandi ntihamya nyir’ikofi.

entries.en: The displayed records have expired. Refresh before continuing.
entries.rw: Amakuru agaragara arashaje. Banza uyavugurure mbere yo gukomeza.

entries.en: Use a name of 2–100 characters without control characters.
entries.rw: Koresha izina rifite inyuguti 2–100 ridafite ibimenyetso bigenzura inyandiko.

entries.en: No recorded events in this response
entries.rw: Nta bikorwa byanditswe muri aya makuru

entries.en: The operation was rejected by the authoritative service. Refresh the records before continuing.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cyanzwe na sisitemu nyamukuru. Vugurura amakuru mbere yo gukomeza.

entries.en: Nothing has been submitted. Credentials will be cleared.
entries.rw: Nta cyoherejwe. Amakuru yo kwinjira arasibwa.

entries.en: Receipt rejected; review the source without retrying a financial action.
entries.rw: Inyemezabwishyu yanze; genzura aho yaturutse utarongeye igikorwa cy’amafaranga.
Ibikorwa %1$d muri %2$d byanditswe · ibya kera bibanza

entries.en: Refresh the status and contact the administrator. Do not infer successful processing from a heartbeat or a network connection.
entries.rw: Vugurura uko bihagaze kandi uvugane n’umuyobozi. Kuba telefoni ikora cyangwa ifite interineti ntibihamya ko igikorwa cyarangiye neza.

entries.en: Records are hidden while the app is not active.
Receipt uploaded; this does not confirm a member credit.
entries.rw: Inyemezabwishyu yoherejwe; ntibyemeza ko amafaranga yashyizwe kuri konti y’umunyamuryango.

entries.en: Managed setup required. Contact your admin.
entries.rw: Igenamiterere ry’umuyobozi rirakenewe. Vugana n’umuyobozi wawe.

entries.en: More records are available. Use Load more to continue.
entries.rw: Hari izindi nyandiko. Kanda kuri Erekana ibindi kugira ngo ukomeze.

entries.en: Original SMS unavailable. Retry loading or go back.
entries.rw: Ubutumwa bw’umwimerere ntibubonetse. Ongera usabe amakuru cyangwa usubire inyuma.

entries.en: New-message capture is paused. Previously retained receipts are not erased by pausing; review the queue before resuming.
entries.rw: Kwakira ubutumwa bushya birahagaze. Guhagarika ntibisiba inyemezabwishyu zari zibitswe; genzura ibitegereje mbere yo gukomeza.

entries.en: Ask your administrator to reauthorize this installation. Retained receipts must keep their original source binding.
entries.rw: Saba umuyobozi kongera guha iyi porogaramu uburenganzira. Inyemezabwishyu zibitswe zigomba kugumana aho zakomotse.

entries.en: The previous action was rejected. Review the records before starting a different action.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cyabanje cyanzwe. Genzura amakuru mbere yo gutangira ikindi gikorwa.

entries.en: Use an identification note of 8–500 characters without control characters.
entries.rw: Koresha ibisobanuro bifite inyuguti 8–500 bidafite ibimenyetso bigenzura inyandiko.

entries.en: A previous action is still pending. Check its authoritative result before doing anything else.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cyabanje kiracyategereje. Banza ugenzure igisubizo cya sisitemu nyamukuru mbere yo gukora ikindi.

entries.en: The retained-receipt count is unknown. Do not clear app data or reinstall to resolve this; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Umubare w’inyemezabwishyu zibitswe ntuzwi. Ntusibe amakuru cyangwa ngo wongere ushyiremo porogaramu; vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: Receipt upload is intentionally held. Local capture can continue if enabled, but queued receipts are not confirmed member credit.
entries.rw: Kohereza inyemezabwishyu byahagaritswe ku bushake. Kwakira kuri telefoni bishobora gukomeza iyo bifunguye, ariko inyemezabwishyu zitegereje ntizemeza amafaranga y’umunyamuryango.

entries.en: Refresh the receiving-phone status. No capture, upload or member credit has been verified by this status check.
entries.rw: Vugurura uko telefoni yakira ihagaze. Iri genzura ntiryemeje kwakira, kohereza cyangwa amafaranga y’umunyamuryango.

entries.en: This record is unavailable. Go back or refresh.
entries.rw: Aya makuru ntabonetse. Subira inyuma cyangwa uvugurure.

entries.en: The bound Android subscription is unavailable. Ask the administrator to verify the business SIM; do not relabel retained receipts.
entries.rw: Umurongo wa Android wahujwe ntuboneka. Saba umuyobozi kugenzura SIM y’ubucuruzi; ntuhindure aho inyemezabwishyu zibitswe zakomotse.

entries.en: Outcome not confirmed. Check before retrying.
entries.rw: Icyavuye mu gikorwa ntikiremezwa. Banza ugenzure mbere yo kongera kugerageza.

entries.en: Server sign-out is unconfirmed. Sign in again to check access.
entries.rw: Gusohoka kuri seriveri ntibyemejwe. Ongera winjire ugenzure uburenganzira.

entries.en: Repeated receipt observation; no additional credit is implied.
entries.rw: Inyemezabwishyu yagaragaye inshuro zirenze imwe; ntibivuga ko hari andi mafaranga yiyongereye.

entries.en: Staff account unavailable. Go back and refresh the staff list.
entries.rw: Konti y’umukozi ntibonetse. Subira inyuma uvugurure urutonde rw’abakozi.

entries.en: Receipt delivery status is unavailable; no member credit is implied.
entries.rw: Uko kohereza inyemezabwishyu bihagaze ntikuboneka; ntibyemeza amafaranga y’umunyamuryango.
Nimero ya telefoni cyangwa umubare w’ibanga si byo.

entries.en: Member unavailable. Go back or refresh.
entries.rw: Amakuru y’umunyamuryango ntabonetse. Subira inyuma cyangwa uvugurure.

entries.en: Local capture is enabled. A zero queue or recent upload does not by itself prove a new receipt or a member credit.
entries.rw: Kwakira kuri telefoni birakora. Kuba nta bitegereje cyangwa ko hari ibyoherejwe vuba ntibihagije kwemeza inyemezabwishyu nshya cyangwa amafaranga y’umunyamuryango.

entries.en: Use the Collect staff account approved for this phone.
entries.rw: Koresha konti y’umukozi wa Collect yemerewe iyi telefoni.

entries.en: Receipt delivery is separate from member credit.
entries.rw: Kohereza inyemezabwishyu bitandukanye no gushyira amafaranga kuri konti y’umunyamuryango.
Amakuru yarahindutse. Banza uyavugurure mbere yo gukomeza.

entries.en: The original action committed, but its financial effect changed. Review the current ledger; do not repeat the original action.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cya mbere cyanditswe, ariko ingaruka zacyo ku mafaranga zarahindutse. Genzura ibaruramari rigezweho; ntusubiremo igikorwa cya mbere.

entries.en: The original action committed, but its financial effect was reversed or corrected. Review the current ledger; do not repeat the original action.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cya mbere cyanditswe, ariko ingaruka zacyo ku mafaranga zasubijwe inyuma cyangwa zirakosorwa. Genzura ibaruramari rigezweho; ntusubiremo igikorwa cya mbere.

entries.en: Receipts remain in the local queue. Upload acknowledgement and canonical member credit are separate outcomes.
entries.rw: Inyemezabwishyu ziracyategereje kuri telefoni. Kwemeza kohereza no kwemeza amafaranga y’umunyamuryango ni ibintu bitandukanye.

entries.en: Saved history · may be out of date
Records stay hidden until your session and current records have been checked.
entries.rw: Amakuru akomeza guhishwa kugeza igihe uburenganzira bwawe n’amakuru agezweho bigenzuwe.

entries.en: Refresh the receiving-phone status and follow the displayed recovery steps.
entries.rw: Vugurura uko telefoni yakira ihagaze kandi ukurikize amabwiriza yo gukemura ikibazo agaragara.

entries.en: This account will no longer have access.
entries.rw: Iyi konti ntizongera kugira uburenganzira bwo kwinjira.

entries.en: Phone replacement and SIM changes require the administrator's controlled procedure. Do not move the SIM, reset app data or discard the queue as a recovery shortcut.
entries.rw: Gusimbuza telefoni no guhindura SIM bisaba gukurikiza amabwiriza y’umuyobozi. Ntukimure SIM, ntusibe amakuru ya porogaramu kandi ntusibe ibitegereje koherezwa nk’uburyo bwihuse bwo gukemura ikibazo.

entries.en: Awaiting upload; not a confirmed member credit.
Only canonical payment and ledger records confirm member credit. Never add the local queue to displayed savings.
entries.rw: Amakuru y’ubwishyu n’igitabo byemejwe na sisitemu nyamukuru ni byo byonyine byemeza amafaranga y’umunyamuryango. Ntukongere amafaranga akiri mu butegereze kuri telefoni ku bwizigame bugaragara.

entries.en: Contact admin for help completing Collect sign-in.
entries.rw: Vugana n’umuyobozi agufashe kwinjira muri Collect.

entries.en: Still awaiting an authoritative outcome. Do not repeat this action; contact the administrator if it remains unresolved.
entries.rw: Haracyategerejwe igisubizo cya sisitemu nyamukuru. Ntusubiremo iki gikorwa; vugana n’umuyobozi niba kidakemutse.
Banza ufungure umunyamuryango mbere yo gusohora urutonde.

entries.en: Passcode change not confirmed. Sign in again.
entries.rw: Guhindura umubare w’ibanga ntibiremezwa. Ongera winjire.

entries.en: Received inconsistent records. Refresh or contact support.
entries.rw: Amakuru yakiriwe ntahuye. Vugurura cyangwa usabe ubufasha.

entries.en: Unable to sign in. Check your connection or contact admin.
entries.rw: Kwinjira ntibyakunze. Suzuma interineti cyangwa uvugane n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: An earlier action may have been submitted. Discarding this draft does not cancel it. Check the previous action before retrying.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cyabanje gishobora kuba cyaroherejwe. Kureka ibyanditswe ntibigisubika. Banza ugenzure igikorwa cyabanje mbere yo kongera kugerageza.

entries.en: Email or password could not be verified.
Contact your administrator to configure this phone.
entries.rw: Saba umuyobozi wawe gushyiraho igenamiterere ry’iyi telefoni.

entries.en: Review the requested Android permissions. Grant access only on the approved receiving phone, then refresh this status.
entries.rw: Genzura uburenganzira bwa Android busabwa. Butange gusa kuri telefoni yakira yemejwe, hanyuma uvugurure uko ihagaze.

entries.en: Too many attempts. Try again later.
entries.rw: Wagerageje inshuro nyinshi. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.

entries.en: This build cannot pair or upload receipts. Use it only for the documented offline checks.
entries.rw: Iyi porogaramu ntishobora guhuza telefoni cyangwa kohereza inyemezabwishyu. Yikoreshe gusa mu igenzura ridakoresha interineti ryateganyijwe.
Nta interineti. Ongera uhuze interineti uvugurure.

entries.en: This history is too large for the phone. Contact an administrator for a full extract.
entries.rw: Aya mateka ni menshi kuri telefoni. Saba umuyobozi urutonde rwose.

entries.en: These records have expired. Reconnect and refresh before continuing.
entries.rw: Aya makuru arashaje. Ongera uhuze interineti uyavugurure mbere yo gukomeza.

entries.en: Payment unavailable. Go back or refresh.
entries.rw: Amakuru y’ubwishyu ntabonetse. Subira inyuma cyangwa uvugurure.

entries.en: Only canonical transaction and ledger records are shown. A transaction record is not confirmation of member credit.
entries.rw: Hagaragazwa gusa ibikorwa n’ibyanditswe mu gitabo byemejwe na sisitemu nyamukuru. Kuba igikorwa cyanditswe ntibihamya ko amafaranga yashyizwe kuri konti y’umunyamuryango.

entries.en: A previous action still needs confirmation. Refreshing or signing out does not cancel it.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cyabanje kiracyakeneye kugenzurwa. Kuvugurura cyangwa gusohoka ntibigisubika.

entries.en: Saved position could not be fully restored. Refresh when connected.
entries.rw: Ahantu wari ugeze ntihashoboye gusubizwaho hose. Ongera uvugurure ufite interineti.

entries.en: Saved position is beyond this list. Showing the nearest available position.
entries.rw: Ahantu wari ugeze harenze uru rutonde. Harerekanwa ahari hafi hashoboka.

entries.en: The previous action needs authenticated reconciliation. Do not repeat it; contact your administrator if the session changed.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cyabanje gikeneye kugenzurwa n’ufite uburenganzira. Ntukigisubiremo; vugana n’umuyobozi niba uburenganzira bwo kwinjira bwahindutse.

entries.en: Scroll amount to view all digits
Reopen this staff account from the refreshed list before saving. Your draft has not been submitted.
entries.rw: Ongera ufungure iyi konti y’umukozi ku rutonde rwavuguruwe mbere yo kubika. Ibyanditswe ntibiratangazwa.

entries.en: Unable to complete. Refresh and try again.
No eligible members. Change the search or ask an administrator.
entries.rw: Nta banyamuryango bujuje ibisabwa babonetse. Hindura ibyo ushakisha cyangwa ubaze umuyobozi.

entries.en: Local recovery storage is unavailable. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Ububiko bwo kuri iyi telefoni bukenewe mu kugarura amakuru ntibuboneka. Ntusubiremo igikorwa cyangwa ngo usibe amakuru ya porogaramu; vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: Recovery evidence is inconsistent. The action remains unresolved; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Amakuru yo kugenzura igikorwa ntahuye. Igisubizo cyacyo ntikiramenyekana; vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: The original action could not be verified for this account and phone. Do not repeat it or clear app data; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cya mbere nticyashoboye kugenzurwa kuri iyi konti n’iyi telefoni. Ntukigisubiremo cyangwa ngo usibe amakuru ya porogaramu; vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: The previous action needs an authenticated outcome check. Sign in with the same operator on this phone and check it. Do not repeat the action.
entries.rw: Igisubizo cy’igikorwa cyabanje kigomba kugenzurwa nyuma yo kwinjira. Injira ukoresheje konti y’umukozi wakigize kuri iyi telefoni maze ukigenzure. Ntusubiremo igikorwa.

entries.en: Action not accepted. Review the details.
Sign in again to check the original action. Do not submit it again.
entries.rw: Kugenzura igisubizo byahagaritswe. Igikorwa cya mbere kiracyategereje igisubizo; ubaze umuyobozi.

entries.en: An outcome check is already running. Do not repeat the financial action.
entries.rw: Kugenzura igisubizo biracyakorwa. Tegereza; ntusubiremo igikorwa cya mbere.

entries.en: Outcome checks have stopped. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Kugenzura ibisubizo byahagaritswe. Ntusubiremo igikorwa cyangwa ngo usibe amakuru ya porogaramu; ubaze umuyobozi.

entries.en: The next outcome check is not due yet. The original action remains unresolved.
entries.rw: Tegereza mbere yo kongera kugenzura igisubizo. Ntusubiremo igikorwa cya mbere.

entries.en: Recovery evidence changed or conflicts with the original action. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Kugenzura igisubizo byahagaritswe. Igikorwa cya mbere kiracyategereje igisubizo; ubaze umuyobozi.
